name: Lazy Lions
rootCause: Discord for NFT series Lazy Lions was hacked. Notably, this attack appears to infiltrate many other large NFT projects throughout the day, seemingly due to MEE6 staff being able to use MEE6 remotely to give themselves roles in any server.
